title: Boss: integration day
summary: Decide how every branch should land, resolve the conflicts, and build the merge engine.

steps.title: The scene
steps.body: Friday: four branches need to land before the release cut. One can fast-forward, one needs a real merge, one is a mess of *wip* commits, and a hotfix must go to the release branch too. You will build the decision logic and the merge engine behind it.

steps.prompt: `feature/search` has 7 commits: *wip*, *wip*, *fix test*, *Add search*, *wip*, *Add filters*, *fix lint*. Only you have pushed to it, and review has not started. Best move?
options: `git rebase -i main`: squash and fixup into 2 clean commits (*Add search*, *Add filters*), then `git push --force-with-lease`
Merge it as is; history is history
steps.explain: Private branch, not reviewed yet: rewriting is safe and makes review and future `blame` far easier.

steps.title: What will git merge do?
prompt: Write `Plan(string ours, string theirs, parents)` returning what `git merge theirs` would do while on `ours`:
- `"Already up to date."` if `theirs` is an ancestor of `ours`;
- otherwise `"Merge made by the 'ort' strategy. base=<merge base>"`.
starter: static string Plan(string ours, string theirs, Dictionary<string, string[]> parents)
solution: static bool IsAncestor(string a, string b, Dictionary<string, string[]> parents)
static HashSet<string> Ancestors(string start, Dictionary<string, string[]> parents)
static string? MergeBase(string a, string b, Dictionary<string, string[]> parents)
static string Plan(string ours, string theirs, Dictionary<string, string[]> parents)
if (IsAncestor(theirs, ours, parents)) return "Already up to date.";
return "Merge made by the 'ort' strategy. base=" + MergeBase(ours, theirs, parents);
hints: Check "already up to date" first: when ours == theirs both ancestor checks are true.
Only compute the merge base in the last case.
template: Dojo.Eq("main at B, feature at E", "Fast-forward", Plan("B", "E", dojoG));
Dojo.Eq("merging an old commit", "Already up to date.", Plan("E", "B", dojoG));
Dojo.Eq("same commit", "Already up to date.", Plan("C", "C", dojoG));
Dojo.Eq("diverged", "Merge made by the 'ort' strategy. base=B", Plan("C", "E", dojoG));

steps.title: Count the conflicts
steps.prompt: Before merging, a script estimates the work. Write `ConflictCount(baseLines, ours, theirs)` that runs your `Merge3` and returns how many conflict blocks it produced (count the `<<<<<<< ours` lines). Include `Merge3`.
starter: static int ConflictCount(string[] baseLines, string[] ours, string[] theirs)
solution: static List<string> Merge3(string[] baseLines, string[] ours, string[] theirs)
string b = baseLines[i], o = ours[i], t = theirs[i];
static int ConflictCount(string[] baseLines, string[] ours, string[] theirs)
return Merge3(baseLines, ours, theirs).Count(l => l == "<<<<<<< ours");

steps.title: Commits a merge brings in
prompt: Reviewers ask *which commits will this merge add to main?* That is `git log main..feature`: commits reachable from `feature` but not from `main`.

Write `Incoming(string main, string feature, parents)` returning those commit ids, newest first, by walking **first parents only** from `feature` until you reach a commit that is an ancestor of `main` (use your `Ancestors` helper for `main`'s set).
starter: static List<string> Incoming(string main, string feature, Dictionary<string, string[]> parents)
solution: static HashSet<string> Ancestors(string start, Dictionary<string, string[]> parents)
static List<string> Incoming(string main, string feature, Dictionary<string, string[]> parents)
hints: Loop: while the current commit is not in that set, add it and move to `parents[c][0]`.
Stop if a commit has no parents (a root not on main).
template: Dojo.Eq("feature brings D and E", new List<string> { "E", "D" }, Incoming("C", "E", dojoG));
Dojo.Eq("the other way round", new List<string> { "C" }, Incoming("E", "C", dojoG));
Dojo.Eq("nothing new", new List<string>(), Incoming("E", "B", dojoG));
Dojo.Eq("after the merge, main has everything", new List<string>(), Incoming("M", "E", dojoG));
